items.title: CLEAN BODY AND GLASS
items.text: Wipe off any adhesive left on the body or glass with alcohol.

content.description: Hand wiping glass and body surface with cloth to clean adhesive

items.title: INSTALL WEATHERSTRIP ON GLASS
steps: (a) Attach the weatherstrip to the glass.

content.text: CAUTION: If the weatherstrip has hardened, it may develop water leaks. Use a new one if necessary.
(b) Apply a working cord along the weatherstrip groove as shown.

content.description: Rear window glass with weatherstrip attached, showing working cord placement in groove

items.title: INSTALL GLASS
steps: (a) Apply soapy water to the contact face of the weatherstrip lip and to the flange.

content.description: Applying soapy water to weatherstrip and flange area of glass

content.text: NOTE: Begin installation in the middle of the lower part of the glass.
(b) Hold the glass in position on the body.
(c) Install the glass by pulling the working cord from the interior, while pushing the outside of the weatherstrip with your open hand.

content.description: Installing glass by pulling working cord from interior while pushing weatherstrip from outside

content.text: (d) To snug the glass in place, tap from the outside with your open hand.

content.description: Tapping glass from outside to secure it in place
